title: The Bizarre Biology Behind How Deer Shed Their Antlers
description: Discover the incredible biological process behind how deer shed their massive antlers every winter.
instagram_caption:
Did you know deer shed their antlers every single year? 🦌 This mind-blowing biological process involves a drop in testosterone and specialized bone-eating cells that help snap the solid bone clean off. Nature is wild! 

#wildlife #deer #nature #science #outdoors

segments.narration: Imagine shaking your head so hard that your own skull bones snap off and fly into the dirt. Every winter, male deer do exactly this to rid themselves of their heavy headwear.

segments.narration: With a sudden, violent shake or a quick bump against a branch, the heavy antlers snap clean off, leaving the deer instantly lighter and completely pain-free.

segments.narration: The small wounds heal over in just a few days, while the discarded antlers on the forest floor become a vital, nutrient-rich buffet for forest rodents.
